Slovakia · one day on foot

A day in
Bratislava

Brunch, pastel-blue walls, old lanes and castle views. Plenty of room to wander, with dinner left open.

Our plan for Saturday 26 September 2026: arrive at Bratislava hl. st. at 10:00, walk to brunch, and leave dinner at 20:00 for the 20:50 departure.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Brána do života to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
